# Agent Reach

> Give your AI agent eyes to see the internet. Agent Reach installs, routes, and health-checks upstream tools for 10 platforms — Twitter/X, Reddit, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, GitHub, LinkedIn, RSS, web search, and any web page. One install, zero API fees.

## Quick Start

- [Installation Guide](https://github.com/lover333101/Agent-Reach/blob/main/docs/install.md): Step-by-step setup instructions for AI agents
- [README](https://github.com/lover333101/Agent-Reach/blob/main/README.md): Full documentation

## Core Commands

- [CLI Usage](https://github.com/lover333101/Agent-Reach/blob/main/docs/install.md): `agent-reach doctor --json` shows the active backend; agents then call upstream tools directly (`opencli`, `twitter`, `rdt`, `yt-dlp`, `gh`, `mcporter`, etc.).

## Key Features

- Read any URL: tweets, Reddit posts, Facebook pages/feed/groups, Instagram profiles/posts, YouTube videos (transcripts), GitHub repos, articles, RSS feeds
- Search/discover across platforms: Twitter/X, Reddit, Facebook, Instagram user search, GitHub, YouTube, LinkedIn, Web (via Exa)
- Self-diagnosis: `agent-reach doctor` checks what works and what needs setup
- Auto-installs dependencies: `agent-reach install --env=auto`
- Browser-session / cookie auth for platforms that require login (Twitter, Reddit, Facebook, Instagram)
- Proxy support for platforms that block server IPs (Reddit, Twitter)
- Audio transcription for videos and podcasts without subtitles: `agent-reach transcribe URL`
- Zero API fees: all backends are free and open-source (OpenCLI, twitter-cli, rdt-cli, yt-dlp, Jina Reader, mcporter/Exa, etc.)

## Troubleshooting

- [Troubleshooting Guide](https://github.com/lover333101/Agent-Reach/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): Common issues and solutions

## Optional

- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/lover333101/Agent-Reach/blob/main/agent_reach/skill/SKILL.md): Integration guide for AI agent frameworks (OpenClaw, Claude Code, etc.)
- Package install: `pip install https://github.com/lover333101/Agent-Reach/archive/main.zip` (the `agent-reach` name on PyPI belongs to an unrelated project)
